data.description: This giant pearl is carved with entwined flying dragons and strung on a fine silver chain; the pearl changes size according to the size of the wearer so that its diameter is no greater than the wearer's thumb. Once per day, the wearer can breathe a cone of searing flame that functions as Burning Hands, except it deals electricity damage instead of fire. If the dragon god Apsu is the wearer's patron: once per day the wearer can use Eagle's Splendor; on command, the orb glows with a Light spell or darkens again.
